aboutGame.title: What is Jev AI?
paragraphs: Jev AI is TypeSafe's structured decision model for applications that need fast, typed answers such as a selected category, a numeric score, or a yes-or-no judgment. It is built for product logic, routing, scoring, and classification rather than long-form text generation.

Jev AI Guides collects beginner explanations, API patterns, integration notes, model comparisons, and practical use cases in one tutorial hub for builders who want to understand where Jev AI fits inside real software workflows.

explore.title: Explore Jev AI Guides

modules.name: Jev AI Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start here if you want the clean mental model: Jev AI handles bounded decisions, while generative models handle writing and open-ended reasoning.

highlights.detail: Learn the difference between structured decisions and free-form generation.
Identify the state your application can safely send into a decision call.
Choose a narrow question your code can act on immediately.
Route the typed result into product logic, review queues, or analytics.

modules.name: Jev AI Access Guide
modules.description: Find the practical routes for using Jev AI now, from the official TypeSafe Playground and API key flow to provider listings developers can test.

highlights.detail: Try a Noul, Choice, or Score question in the TypeSafe Playground before writing code.
Call POST /v1/systemone with a TypeSafe API key and the jev-latest model alias.
Use Cloudflare Workers AI, Vercel AI Gateway, or OpenRouter when that provider path fits your stack.
Keep high-impact actions behind code rules, thresholds, logging, and human review.

modules.name: Jev AI Decision Primitives
modules.description: Understand the three core Jev AI primitives and the product situations where each one makes sense.

highlights.label: Choice
highlights.detail: Pick one option from a defined set such as ticket type, next tool, or moderation category.

highlights.label: Score
highlights.detail: Rate an ordered scale such as urgency, quality, intent strength, or customer sentiment.

highlights.label: Noul
highlights.detail: Answer a bounded yes-or-no question for filters, gates, checks, and simple classifiers.

highlights.label: Batch
highlights.detail: Ask several related decisions over the same input so the workflow can branch cleanly.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Jev AI.

items.question: What is Jev AI?
items.answer: Jev AI is TypeSafe's structured decision model for applications that need typed outputs such as a category, score, or yes-or-no answer.

items.question: What is Jev AI used for?
items.answer: Jev AI is used for routing, classification, scoring, moderation checks, workflow triage, support queues, and agent tool-selection decisions.

items.question: Can Jev AI write articles or chat like ChatGPT?
items.answer: Jev AI is designed for bounded decisions, not long-form writing or open-ended chat. For writing and conversation, pair Jev AI with a generative model.

items.question: Where should beginners start with Jev AI?
items.answer: Beginners should start with the Jev AI beginner guide, then learn the Choice, Score, and Noul primitives before building an API workflow.
